activity_summary: You ate bacon and pease-pottage and took the loft for two pence. The hay was last year's. She sent you up the ladder once you had eaten.

facets.activity: Paid two pence for the loft

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Both. And the loft, if the loft is two pence

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two pence. I am not arguing a loft down
